fact: By early 2022 DHIS2 was implemented in the Mauritius HMIS for aggregate data for IDSR and EPI and tracker data for AEFI, COVID-19 vaccination, hepatitis, HIV and TB, with regional health facilities entering data and decentralisation to district and primary health care level still planned.
title: Integrating DHIS2 data with VigiFlow for reporting AEFI cases in Mauritius
